name: Plague Storm
description: The Plagueborn opens a blooming cloud of pestilence over a wide stretch of ground.

effects.text: Plague Storm bursts over every foe in the cloud.
The cloud festers inside the wounds.

runes.name: Corpse Bloom
runes.description: The cloud spreads far wider, but the initial burst is weaker.

runes.name: Famine
runes.description: A denser cloud that bursts hard and costs less Venom.

runes.name: Total Rot
runes.description: The plague never leaves the lungs it enters.

name: Toxic Volley
description: A spray of tainted daggers that poisons everything it spares.

effects.text: The volley wounds every foe in its path.

runes.name: Acid Rain
runes.description: The volley falls like rain over a much wider patch of the pit.

runes.name: Focused Volley
runes.description: A tighter volley that hits far harder and returns to the hand sooner.

name: Blight Aura
description: A miasma of sickness surrounds the Plagueborn and rots anything that comes close.

effects.text: The aura sickens every foe in the miasma.
The reek drags the living to a crawl.

runes.name: Pestilence
runes.description: The miasma rolls outward to swallow a much larger stretch of ground.

runes.name: Wither
runes.description: A denser cloud that rots faster but does not spread as far.

name: Twin Fang
description: Two quick fangs of a tainted blade puncture the target and leave venom behind.

effects.text: The first fang opens the wound.
The second fang empties its venom.

runes.name: Venom Fang
runes.description: The fangs carry far more venom and take far longer to work out.

runes.name: Shadow Fang
runes.description: A quicker, sharper bite that comes back for more.

name: Corrode
description: A dripping strike that eats through armour and leaves the foe crippled.

effects.text: Corrode melts through the target's guard.
The corroded foe strikes far weaker.

runes.name: Dissolve
runes.description: A heavier dose that melts the target down for a price of Venom.

runes.name: Rust
runes.description: A quicker dose whose corroded wound keeps the target crippled.
